summary: Twenty years in Bondi Junction and a 4.9 rating are strong, but conflicting phone numbers, dead menus and template leftovers cost you enquiries.

findings.problem: Two phone numbers appear: 02 5502 1236 on the page and (02) 8999 3795 behind the Call Now button.
findings.cost: Patients may reach a different line than the one they see, and some calls are lost.

findings.problem: The Patients, Prices and Blog menu items link to #, and several buttons point to #open, #book and #pricelist anchors.
findings.cost: Patients looking for prices or booking hit dead ends.
findings.fix: Working menus and a clear price list page.

findings.problem: Leftover text shows: Circle IconArrow Icon, This field is for validation purposes and should be left unchanged, and No results found. after the case studies. Several blocks appear twice.
findings.cost: Template debris makes a premium practice look unfinished.
findings.fix: Clean content with each section shown once.

findings.problem: The page claims 4.9 stars and 85+ Google reviews but shows no review text, no before and after images appear, and 21 years conflicts with since 2006.
findings.cost: Veneer and implant patients want proof, and conflicting claims weaken it.
findings.fix: A review wall, captioned results and consistent facts.

redesign: One phone number, clean menus and a simple booking path.
A Google review wall and a captioned before and after gallery.
